instruction: Right now you are standing near the bed. Make a slight left turn and go closer near to the open door of the bed room . From there make a slight right turn and walk through the corridor and again make a slight left turn and walk through the corridor up to where you can see a horse painted frame on the wall and make a slight right turn near the horse painted frame and just step into that room and go straight where you can see a curtain from the curtain make a slight right turn. In front you can see a opened door. Just get into that room it is an empty cupboards. Here we reached our destination in front of the opened door of the room.
